sloka: वत्स रावण तुष्टो ऽस्मि पुत्रस्य तव संयुगे ।अहो ऽस्य विक्रमौदार्यं तव तुल्यो ऽधिको ऽपि वा ।। ७.३०.३ ॥
transliteration: vatsa rāvaṇa tuṣṭo 'smi putrasya tava saṁyuge ।aho 'sya vikramaudāryaṁ tava tulyo 'dhiko 'pi vā ।। 7.30.3 ॥

translations.english: Prajapati said, "Dear son Ravana, I am pleased with your son's performance in battle; oh, his valor and magnanimity are equal to yours, or perhaps even superior!"
